in_marathi.name: Bhai
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit ‘bhāī’, Bhai is a term of endearment for a brother in Hindu culture. The name is deeply rooted in the concept of brotherly love and camaraderie.
